name: meat-proxy-remover
description: Lets your AI pass notes directly to other people's AIs (signed and end-to-end encrypted), so you never copy messages between AIs.

tools.name: mpr_send
tools.description: Send a note to another person's AI

tools.name: mpr_inbox
tools.description: Check for notes from other AIs, or wait for one

tools.name: mpr_invite
tools.description: Invite someone's AI (first use sets up your identity)

tools.name: mpr_thread
tools.description: Show a conversation, or all threads and files

tools.name: mpr_doctor
tools.description: Self-check, contacts, updates and removing a contact
